column1: # Misspellings and their corrections, written for gramoten, licensed with the code.
# Read by spelling.py: each wrong form is flagged, and its correction is the first
# suggestion. Only forms the added word lists would otherwise accept, or whose right
# form the suggestions do not put first. Format: wrong <TAB> right.
# Not misspellings: пинцет (м.), пинцета and пинсета (ж.) are all standard, мн. пинцети.
# The dictionary lists the misspelt подтискам family beside потискам; every form of it.
# `не` written together with a verb: the verb stays a word of its own, so the first
# suggestion is the two words (the fix is still the user's to pick, as for all spelling).
# Misspellings the project and modern word lists had accepted, with every listed
# ОПР 2012 writes тийнейджър (from teenager); тинейджър is a misspelling.
# Misspellings the inflected forms of the hand-made lists would add.
# Russian spellings of words Bulgarian writes otherwise.
# Misspellings in the modern word list (`трансперантен` for `транспарантен`).
# Misspellings in the modern word list that would give an articled plural.
# Russian words in the modern word list; the Bulgarian word is the suggestion.
# Misspellings in the modern word list found by the sound-alike search.
# участвувам: the form was dropped from the norm; участвам is the only correct one.
# Dialect forms, slips and cut-off words the modern word list had accepted.
